text:
I've built a CLI tool called `proprietary_scanner.sh` that scans for potentially proprietary software on Linux systems. It detects packages not from official repositories (e.g., AUR on Arch-based distros) and flags them as potentially proprietary.

To use it:
```bash
./proprietary_scanner.sh
```

The tool is tailored for Arch/CachyOS but can be adapted for other distros. It found 33 unofficial packages on your system, which may include proprietary software—check their licenses for accuracy.
